O.content: The red square at 11-18 years is higher on the page than the blue circular mark at the same category.
The left axis label is blue and the right axis label is red; no numeric y-axis tick labels are visibly printed.
Blue circular marks are connected by a solid blue line, while red square marks are connected by a dashed red line.

B.text: If the blue and red series use separate colored y-axes and neither axis has visible numeric tick labels, their screen-space heights cannot by themselves establish a comparable cross-category value ordering; without a stated escalation criterion, the comparison should be sent for reference review.
B.conditions: Applies when no supplied policy defines how plotted values or category labels map to a follow-up route.

O.content: The title reads “High fibre breakfast cereals vs Other breakfast cereals.”
The blue axis label reads “High fibre breakfast cereals.”
A blue circular mark is shown at the 11-18 years position.

B.text: If the routing instruction treats the chart category explicitly labeled “High fibre breakfast cereals” as the category requiring adolescent fibre-support follow-up, then that labeled category maps to the high-fibre follow-up option.
B.conditions: Requires an unstated program rule that the high-fibre category itself, rather than a plotted cross-series comparison, determines fibre-support routing.
